purpose: Measure matched real simulator futures for frozen production A0/A1/A2 candidates without controller evaluation or model selection.

scope.seed_rule: Use the already preregistered controller-development seed paired with each selected init-state index: 30000 + 100*task_id + episode_position.

branch_construction.reference_path: Generate one frozen C0-v2 actor-default trajectory from the official episode start. At each preregistered planning index, generate frozen A0/A1/A2 exactly once and copy that tensor to all branches.
branch_construction.branch_path: Create three fresh independent environments, seed/reset/set the same official init state, replay the exact stored raw physical prefix actions, then execute one copied candidate for eight actions.
branch_construction.prefix_controller: frozen C0-v2 actor default, open-loop chunks of H=8
branch_construction.candidate_generator: frozen C1-v2 deterministic antithetic smoothed Gaussian at production 1x scale

prefix_identity_gate.executed_raw_prefix_actions: bitwise equal float32 arrays and identical SHA-256
prefix_identity_gate.agentview_rgb: bitwise equal uint8 arrays and identical SHA-256
prefix_identity_gate.planning_observation: same keys, shapes, dtypes, and bitwise-equal numeric arrays
prefix_identity_gate.failure_action: stop immediately, retain only a failure audit, assign BLOCK_COUNTERFACTUAL_REPLAY, and exclude the branch point from mechanism metrics

metric_contract.visual_cosine_separation: 1-cosine(z_real_i[h], z_real_j[h]) for pairs A0-A1, A0-A2, A1-A2
metric_contract.pixel_difference: mean absolute uint8 pixel difference, pixel RMSE, and unequal-pixel fraction
metric_contract.proprio_separation: RMSE in frozen train-standardized 12-D proprio plus raw 12-D L2
metric_contract.predicted_visual_separation: same cosine/L2 metrics on each model's candidate-specific predicted latents
metric_contract.wm_v2b_proprio_error: RMSE between predicted and real future proprio in frozen standardized coordinates
metric_contract.transfer_ratio: ratio of group means: mean predicted visual cosine separation / mean real visual cosine separation
metric_contract.near_zero_rule: If a requested group mean real cosine separation is below 1e-5, report ratio as null/insufficient-denominator and always report predicted, real, and signed absolute difference.
metric_contract.correlation: Pearson and Spearman between real standardized-proprio RMSE separation and real visual cosine separation, pooled and per horizon

decision_rules.real_visual_is_meaningful: overall real visual cosine separation / D15 ordinary validation visual error >= 0.01 and at least 6 of 8 horizon means are >= ratio_minimum_real_cosine
decision_rules.real_physical_is_meaningful: overall real standardized-proprio RMSE separation / WM-v2B validation proprio RMSE >= 0.05 and all 8 horizon means are positive
decision_rules.visual_transfer_failure_confirmed: real visual and physical are meaningful, and WM-v2B overall transfer ratio <= 0.50 with predicted separation below real separation on at least 6 of 8 horizons
decision_rules.local_clip_counterfactual_limit: real physical is meaningful, but overall real visual cosine separation / D15 ordinary validation visual error < 0.01 or fewer than 6 horizon means reach ratio_minimum_real_cosine
decision_rules.wm_local_counterfactual_prediction_fail_: mean A1/A2 branch visual error is >=1.50 times that model's frozen ordinary validation error, >=1.10 times its matched A0 branch error, and A1/A2 error exceeds A0 on >55% of matched task/episode/planning-index/horizon points
decision_rules.mixed_verdict: VISUAL_TRANSFER_FAILURE_CONFIRMED and WM_LOCAL_COUNTERFACTUAL_PREDICTION_FAIL may co-occur; LOCAL_CLIP_COUNTERFACTUAL_LIMIT is mutually exclusive with VISUAL_TRANSFER_FAILURE_CONFIRMED by the real-visual gate.
decision_rules.no_named_failure: If no named rule fires and replay passes, report LOCAL_COUNTERFACTUAL_AUDIT_INCONCLUSIVE with the preregistered metrics.

forbidden: train or modify any world model
modify C0-v2, candidate scale, candidate generator, or reranker
use mid-episode flattened simulator state restore
resample candidate noise separately in different branches
record or use reward, success, done, or final task completion
use branch results to tune a controller, threshold, candidate scale, or model
